issues.title: Device registry has placeholder entries
issues.description: device-registry.json contains two example entries (and-001, and-002). Real device data must be entered after the first device-inventory and onboarding.
issues.resolution: Run the new-device-onboard workflow (ask the space agent to run it) for each real device, then remove example entries.

issues.title: ADB / scrcpy binary paths not confirmed
issues.description: adb and scrcpy must be installed (see tools/platform-tools and tools/scrcpy) before any skill will run. With adb_path / scrcpy_path empty in config.yaml they are resolved from PATH, then $ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools.
issues.resolution: Install platform-tools and scrcpy, then confirm `adb version` and `scrcpy --version` work, or set adb_path / scrcpy_path in .navig/config.yaml.

issues.title: adb backup unreliable on Android 12+
issues.description: The app-backup skill relies on 'adb backup', which is deprecated and skipped by many apps (allowBackup=false) on Android 12+. Full app-data backup without root is unreliable.
issues.resolution: Treat media pull (file-transfer) + APK extraction (apk-extract) as the dependable backup core. Use per-app in-app export for critical chat/notes apps. Document exceptions in backup-strategy.
